findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_review_queue, search_orgs, create_giving_intent, decision_brief · Private data: get_review_queue, get_org, search_orgs, list_ledger_records, get_ledger_record, list_charities, verdict_chain · Public sink: search_orgs, create_giving_intent · Destructive: search_orgs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_review_queue, search_orgs, create_giving_intent, decision_brief · Private data: get_review_queue, get_org, search_orgs, list_ledger_records, get_ledger_record, list_charities, verdict_chain · Public sink: search_orgs, create_giving_intent · Destructive: search_orgs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
